geographic_scope: Mumbai Metropolitan Area & South Mumbai Sub-Regions

evidence_summary.verdict_explanation: There is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE to classify any South Mumbai area as experiencing gentrification or displacement. While official RBI transaction records confirm strong city-level housing price appreciation over 15 years (+370.39%), empirical data on localized ward-level prices, demographic turnover, tenant displacement, and construction permits is unavailable from official free sources. In accordance with academic integrity standards, UrbanLens does not assign automated gentrification labels.

anomalies_summary.interpretative_mandate: Detected anomalies represent unusual rate-of-change spikes in housing price index valuations. They serve as triggers for multi-domain verification, NOT automated labels of neighborhood transformation.
